title: Users won't be able to claim vested tokens when contract is paused
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as owner has the power to make it so that users can't claim any vested tokens  **Likelihood:** Low, as it requires a malicious or a compromised owner  ## Description  The owner can currently execute the following attack:  1. Call `setPaused` with `paused == true`, so pause the contract 2. Now all user calls to `releaseAvailableTokensForHolder` will fail, since it has the `whenNotPaused` modifier 3. He can not unpause the contract forever or even renounce ownership  This is a common centralization problem which means the contract owner can "rug" users.  ## Recomme
